title: Actual derived Weil pullback-direct-image adjunction
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes. Use the actual derived Weil categories and the actual restricted functors $f^*$ and $Rf_*$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], whose preservation of bounded constructible cohomology is asserted separately in [lem-sf-native-weil-pullback-star-preservation]. These functors form an adjunction $f^*\dashv Rf_*$. Thus for every $T\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$ and $N\in\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$ there is a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)}(f^*T,N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)}(T,Rf_*N),$$
natural in both variables. The adjunction is the restriction of the derived adjunction of the termwise module inverse image and the right-derived pushforward on $D(\mathcal W)$; its maps are the actual derived unit and counit.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-native-weil-injective-adjunction-model] to the stated finite-field and separated finite-type datum. It supplies the actual underived Weil adjunction, its exact left adjoint, resolutions inside $\mathcal W$, and the K-injective computation of the framework\'s ambient $f^*$ and $Rf_*$. Thus the constructions in [lem-sf-native-weil-derived-hom-comparison] apply to exactly these functors. That node gives the ambient bijections $\Phi_{T,N}$, independent of resolutions and natural in both variables, with the specified identity transposes.

source.place: Tags 070I (lemma-K-injective) and 08BJ (lemma-adjoint-preserve-K-injectives), Hom computation and homotopy adjunction; expanded by an agent to resolution independence, naturality and identity-transpose normalization. Extracted from returned proof steps 4-7.

proof.text: Put $\eta^d_T=\Phi_{T,f^*T}(\mathrm{id})$ and $\varepsilon^d_N=\Phi^{-1}_{Rf_*N,N}(\mathrm{id})$. By [lem-sf-native-weil-derived-hom-comparison] these are the actual derived unit and counit. Naturality gives $\Phi(h)=Rf_*(h)\circ\eta^d_T$ and $\Phi^{-1}(a)=\varepsilon^d_N\circ f^*(a)$. Substituting $h=\varepsilon^d_N$ gives $Rf_*(\varepsilon^d_N)\circ\eta^d_{Rf_*N}=\mathrm{id}$. Substituting $a=\eta^d_T$ gives $\varepsilon^d_{f^*T}\circ f^*(\eta^d_T)=\mathrm{id}$. These are the triangle identities, so the natural Hom bijection defines the specified ambient adjunction.

proof.text: Finally apply [lem-sf-native-weil-pullback-star-preservation] with the stated $f_0,X_0,Y_0$: its hypotheses are exactly the finite-field, separated finite-type hypotheses of this item. Hence $f^*T$ and $Rf_*N$ lie in the required bounded constructible subcategories whenever $T,N$ do. By [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework] these are full subcategories, so both Hom sets in the item are precisely the ambient Hom sets of the bijections $\Phi_{T,N}$ in step 1. Restrict $\Phi$, its naturality, $\eta^d$ and $\varepsilon^d$ to these objects. Fullness retains every unit and counit component; their triangle equalities are the same equalities of ambient morphisms from step 2. This gives every clause of the stated adjunction on the actual restricted functors.
